verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own marketing says it auto-joins calendar meetings and produces notes, decisions and action items 'instantly after every meeting', which covers the timing and structure of the story. Nothing in the pack shows the summaries are accurate or polished enough to share without editing, and all claims are vendor marketing without depth or corroboration. Missing for 10: evidence that summaries are share-ready without editing, documentation of the summary structure and its 'key points' section, independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.

support.subject: As a product manager, I get a structured summary right after each meeting — key points, decisions, and next steps — good enough to share without editing

citations.quote: Get detailed notes, action items, and customized summaries instantly after every meeting.
Fred records, transcribes, & summarizes meetings with notes, decisions, & action items.
have it autojoin your calendar meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize.
